name: secret-guard
description: Add a gitleaks pre-commit hook to each Git project you open in Claude Code: pre-commit for most projects, Husky for JS/TS

autoInstallHusky.title: Auto-install Husky
autoInstallHusky.description: In a JS/TS project without husky, add it as a dev dependency with the project's package manager (changes package.json and the lockfile). When off, secret-guard only shows the install command.
